at 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z

# Project commands require an existing selected store.
! exec card project list
! stdout .
stderr 'no Cardamom store found'
! exists .cardamom

mkdir project-workflow
cd project-workflow
exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix root- --board-name 'Root board'
stdout 'initialized .cardamom'
! exists .git/cardamom-board

# The initial project is available through human and structured catalog output.
exec card project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/initial-projects.txt
exec card --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/initial-projects.jsonl
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/initial-boards.jsonl

# An active store prefix is inherited when project creation omits --prefix.
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.prefix inherited-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card --json project create Inherited
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-project.json
exec card --json board list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/initial-boards.jsonl
! exists .git/cardamom-board
exec card --json board create --project project_11111111111111111111 'Inherited board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-board.json
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 create 'Inherited issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/inherited-issue.txt

# An explicit project prefix overrides the active store prefix.
exec card project create Duplicate --prefix explicit-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-project.txt
exec card --json board create --project project_22222222222222222222 'Explicit board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-board.json
exec card --board board_22222222222222222222 create 'Explicit issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-issue.txt

# Without an active store prefix, the project name supplies the prefix.
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 config unset --scope store issue.id.prefix
exec card --json project create Duplicate
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/inferred-project.json
exec card --json board create --project project_33333333333333333333 'Inferred board'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/inferred-board.json
exec card --board board_33333333333333333333 create 'Inferred issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/inferred-issue.txt
! exec card board create --project Duplicate 'Ambiguous board'
! stdout .
stderr 'project "Duplicate" is ambiguous; use an ID'

# Duplicate names remain distinct catalog entries in deterministic order.
exec card project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/all-projects.txt
exec card --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/all-projects.jsonl

# Repeated init remains non-creating and points to explicit project creation.
exec card init
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/repeated-init.txt
exec card --json project list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/all-projects.jsonl
! exists .git/cardamom-board
